name: BAT
recent: BAT 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收 3.02 亿令吉，净利 230 万令吉，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 2 仙。公司同时指出马来西亚超过一半的卷烟消费涉及逃税。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 2 仙，总额 RM5,710,600，除息日 2026 年 11 月 30 日，派发日 2026 年 12 月 28 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收 3.02 亿令吉，净利 230 万令吉。
公司指出马来西亚超过一半的卷烟消费涉及逃税。
risks: 季度净利同比下跌 95.4%，环比下跌 77.9%，主要受重组成本影响。
马来西亚卷烟市场超过一半涉及逃税，影响合法销售。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM302,024,000，环比下降 41.4%，同比下降 51.7%；净利为 RM2,349,000，环比下降 77.9%，同比下降 95.4%；净利率为 0.8%，上一季度为 2.1%。

recent_en: BAT reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM302 million and net profit of RM2.3 million, and declared a third interim dividend of 2 sen per share. The company also noted that over half of cigarettes consumed in Malaysia evade tax.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 2 sen per share, totalling RM5,710,600, with ex-date on 30 November 2026 and payment date on 28 December 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM302 million and net profit of RM2.3 million.
The company noted that over half of cigarettes consumed in Malaysia evade tax.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit fell 95.4% year-on-year and 77.9% quarter-on-quarter, mainly due to restructuring costs.
Over half of the Malaysian cigarette market involves tax evasion, affecting legal sales.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM302,024,000, down 41.4% QoQ and 51.7% YoY; net profit was RM2,349,000, down 77.9% QoQ and 95.4% YoY; net margin was 0.8% versus 2.1% in the previous quarter.
